parameters.question: Compare chi-square uniformity test results for the distribution of age-related CpG sites across chromosomes in Jackdaw (JD). The chi-square statistic must match within 1% relative error, and degrees of freedom must match exactly. A p-value of 0 is acceptable when the true value is below floating-point precision. Column order and extra columns may differ.

Compare chi-square uniformity test results for Zebra Finch age-related CpG distribution across chromosomes. Chi-square statistic must match within 1% relative absolute error; degrees of freedom must match exactly; a p-value of 0 is acceptable when the true value is below floating-point precision; column order and extra columns may differ.
